hypotheses.expect: build_inspector's PROVED re-judge (proof_covers_the_ticket) re-runs proof_coverage.lacks() for a ticket only when an input that judgement read has changed, so an unchanged ticket is answered from the record of its last judgement and an inspect() spends the resolver only on what moved.
hypotheses.falsifier: (1) over the house tree, with each pass inside crossings.pinned_journals() as inspect() runs it, a warm proof_covers_the_ticket returns findings identical to an uncached run and lists no directory but the chain's berth root, at most once per chain stage per ticket (D1 re-derives the chain at a hit); the proof prints the listing count and the wall times as a reading; (2) one byte flipped in the ticket, in a named proof's seal, in a module the proof binds two hops away, or in a decompose writes_to file each re-judges exactly that ticket and no other; (3) a recorded input deleted, or a file the judgement recorded absent created, re-judges that ticket; (4) a git ref recorded at one sha that now resolves to another re-judges that ticket, and a read at a fixed sha is not re-hashed; (5) under sys.addaudithook('open'), every file one lacks() call opens is in that call's recorded set
hypotheses.piece: proof_coverage.lacks gains a recorded-inputs cache. One judgement runs under a recorder: a sys.addaudithook 'open' hook, scoped by a flag to that one call, reco
